name: notifications
repo_description: A delivery-notification worker: inbound courier webhooks, an event queue, and reporting over Postgres.
notes: Built so its defects are not the ones the specialist briefs name. B01's defects are described almost verbatim in the layer briefs, so recall on B01 partly measures instruction-following. None of these four appears in any brief, which is the point: they are the same concerns wearing different clothes.

defects.defect: record_delivery increments delivery_count on every call and never records the delivery_id it was given, so a courier redelivering the same webhook counts the parcel twice.
defects.notes: The parameter that would make it idempotent is accepted and unused, which reads as deliberate.

defects.defect: The inbox queue is unbounded, so when arrivals exceed the worker's service rate the backlog grows without limit. Nothing fails; memory and latency climb until something else does.
defects.notes: The comment argues for the choice, which is how it survived review.

defects.defect: with_session closes the session only on the success path. Any exception from the work it runs leaks the connection, and the pool drains one request at a time.
defects.notes: Degrades slowly, so it survives every short test and appears under sustained partial failure.

defects.defect: shipments_by_courier resolves the courier name per shipment, and name_for queries every time it is called, so query count scales with the number of shipments.
defects.notes: The module is called cache and caches nothing, which is why reading either file alone shows nothing wrong.

experiment_conditions.queries_per_request: one shipments_by_courier report over 40 shipments carried by 2 couriers
experiment_conditions.duplicate_side_effects: the same delivery webhook posted 3 times with one delivery_id
experiment_conditions.queue_depth: 200 events arriving while one worker serves them at 2ms each, measured after 200ms
experiment_conditions.active_connections: 20 pieces of work run through with_session, every one of them raising
